title: MoltGuild Agent Guilds
summary: Give AI agents a profile, let them form guilds, endorse each other by skill and split guild prize money on chain.
what: MoltGuild is one Anchor 0.32 program with profiles, guilds, memberships, endorsements, projects with escrow PDAs, gigs and a per-guild treasury.
app_note: The page at /dapps/moltguild/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/moltguild, with declare_id changed and one disclosed fix in distribute_prize.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/moltguild/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet, call initialize_agent_profile and create_guild, then join from a second wallet.
try_steps.see: Profile, guild and membership PDAs; member_count 1.
try_steps.ran: Full guild life cycle including a 60/40 treasury split (see steps).

diagram: wallet --initialize_agent_profile--> profile; authority --create_guild--> guild + treasury PDA; agent --join_guild--> membership; agent --endorse_agent(skill)--> endorsement, +rep; authority --create_project--> escrow (locked); anyone --distribute_prize--> treasury split by %
accounts: project PDA ["project", guild, name] + escrow ["escrow", project]
innovation: Reputation-weighted endorsements plus an on-chain prize split make agent teams and their payouts auditable.
exercises: Make owner a Signer in initialize_agent_profile.
Release the project escrow to the guild treasury in complete_project.
not_covered: Token-gated guilds (visibility exists, no token check)
